design:
Child of the multi-thermo flowsheet epic (bn op-186o).


**Small tests before any whole-refinery attempt.**

| case | expectation |
|---|---|
| **PR -> PR**, same species | effectively **identity** — the null test, and the first one to write |
| **PR -> SRK**, same species | exercise TP and PH semantics; quantify the difference |
| **PR petroleum <-> IAPWS water/steam** across a HX | **energy closure** |
| **sour gas -> electrolyte** (H2/H2S/CO2/H2O) | mass, C/H/O/S, **charge**, enthalpy |
| **round trip A -> B -> A** | quantify drift |

## On the round trip

Test it **not because round trips should be routine** — they are the lossy
pattern the epic warns against — but to **quantify information and
thermo-reference drift**. **Report the drift rather than assuming it is zero.**
A round trip that returns exactly the input is evidence the reference states
agree; one that does not, quantifies by how much they disagree, which is
otherwise very hard to measure.

The `PR -> PR` identity case deserves writing first: if it is not exactly
identity, something is wrong in the bridge machinery itself and every other
result is suspect.


## Constraints

Mature-crate refactor: preserve public constructors, deprecate rather than remove, regression tests before semantic changes. Do not implement AGR/Claus/the refinery here. `develop` only, no push to `main`.
title: MultiThermo: Multi-thermo regression and validation suite

design:
Child epic of the integrated petrochemical and polymer platform (bn op-9941 / see #77 programme).

**Fidelity target: Engineering model**

```
propylene -+-> polypropylene
           +-> propylene oxide
           +-> acrylonitrile
           +-> cumene -> phenol + acetone
```

**Cumene connects the propylene system to the benzene/aromatics system** —
this chain cannot be scoped as C3-only, and its benzene demand must be a real
stream draw on the BTX train.

Acrylonitrile introduces **nitrogen** into the petrochemical carbon accounting
(ammoxidation), so the N balance extends beyond hydroprocessing.

Separate sub-issues per chain; shared reaction/separation infrastructure.


## Programme constraints

No monolithic plant solvers. Reuse existing reaction/thermo/separation infrastructure. Conservation preserved across every representation change. Do not push to `main`.
title: Petchem: Propylene derivative chains
